entities.summary: Erik Christian Clemmensen was a Danish-American chemist. He is most commonly associated with the Clemmensen reduction, a method for converting a carbonyl group into a methylene group. Erik Christian Clemmensen was a scientists & inventors from Odense (1876-08-12, Odense–1941-05-21). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
